name: ainet_find_node_by_index
description: AINet::FindNodeByIndex walks an AINetNode list and returns the node whose nodeIndex matches the requested index.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification passes under the /MD CRT import-call AINet source target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x403530 validates fastcall ECX as nodeIndex, EDX as nodeListHead, comparison against AINetNode::nodeIndex at offset 0x28, traversal through next at offset 0x2c, matched-node return, and null return when no match exists.
The native smoke verifies middle-node match, missing-index null, and null-list null behavior.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x403530 --build-root build\vc5-verify-403530-probe passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs; BN size 21, VC object symbol size 32, 11 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
